sets.componentsNote: Composition assembled from the catalogued Surgronic rhinoplasty range (SUR-RHI) per the set descriptions in D1: Standard 24 covers all nine families named in the SUR-SET-001 description (forceps, scissors, elevators, osteotomes, rasps and scrapers, retractors and hooks, nasal speculum, needle holders, knife). Every component is a real catalogued SKU with a verified image. TC 24 swaps four pieces for their tungsten-carbide counterparts named in the SUR-SET-002 description (Cottle TC Scissors, Famon Raspa TC, Maltz Scraper TC, Alp Raspa TC); the Alp Raspa TC takes the place of the Lewis Raspa, the standard-pattern rasp it most directly corresponds to — confirm this substitution with the owner if the TC set should drop a different standard piece. Starter 12 is the essential subset named in the SUR-SET-003 description. All components have no public sales price in D1, so every variant is Price on request (bundle rule: sum of component sales prices less 5%).
sets.source: D1 products table, SKUs SUR-SET-001/002/003 (descriptions) + SUR-RHI-001..106 (component SKUs, all with images, all price_cents null), queried 2026-11-06. Component images copied from site-assets/img/ to website assets (119 files, all valid).
